newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money steady in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money steady in liquid market.

text.p: Manila's overnight money remained wedged at an average 13.03125 percent on Tuesday due to high liquidity, traders said.
Secondary trading in treasury bills was also sideways.
"Most investors were cautious on hopes of another rate increase next week following the slight uptick in the yield of the Philippine 91-day T-bill rate on Monday," said a senior bank trader.
Volume was slightly down at 18.496 billion pesos from Monday's 18.826.
A Reuters poll of eight financial institutions gave offers of 10.125/10.35 percent for the three-month bills; 10.50/10.60 percent for the six months; and 10.95/11.1 for the one-year bills.
